recommendation.selection_limit: fastest median selected on the same data across many settings; unadjusted CIs have selection optimism; no held-out confirmation or universal optimum

accounting.identity_each_round: wall_idle = imbalance + other_wall_idle; efficiency_loss = wall_idle + work_duration_change
accounting.time_decomposition: Tp = T1/p + (max busy - mean busy) + remainder; remainder is signed and not causal attribution
accounting.serial_fraction: Amdahl-equivalent fit from response time; not measured serial code and not additive to the wall-idle terms
accounting.busy: wall time within jobs, including memory waits and descheduling; not CPU utilization
accounting.remaining: startup/barriers/scheduling/instrumentation contribute to other wall idle; work-duration changes include allocation/cache/frequency/contention without causal separation
accounting.aggregation: per-round components are computed before medians; medians need not sum

projection_scope: 64-bit FNV compact final x/z/q/u/w/y/v, objective and feasibility projection; no full-trace bitwise-parity claim
golden_scope: excluded 32-case goldens were checked by the shared independent Python validator; objective components compared bitwise during preparation

hypotheses.load_balance: measured schedule/order sensitivity and per-worker wall accounting; imbalance remains descriptive
hypotheses.physical_p_e_and_hyperthreading: unresolved: guest affinity/SMT topology does not identify physical P/E cores or provide a physical SMT on/off intervention
hypotheses.memory_bandwidth_and_cache: unresolved: no workload hardware counters; perf observation: executable unavailable
hypotheses.allocation: MALLOC_ARENA_MAX sensitivity measured at selected teams; no allocation counters or causal contention attribution
hypotheses.frequency_and_throttling: unresolved: no frequency/temperature time series; governor=unavailable in WSL; frequency=unavailable in WSL; temperature=unavailable in WSL
hypotheses.environment: power plan and app observations are retained; no fixed-frequency or closed-app claim beyond recorded evidence
